artifacts.summary: 10-phase plan (17h, 7 waves) landing the nine derived schemata in DAG-placed modules, repointing every site green, deleting the nine Axiom constructors in one atomic batch with a single whole-tree rebuild, regenerating Typst/tooling outputs, and refreshing prose and docs.

memory_candidates.content: BimodalLogic derived-schema placement is dictated by the Theorems import DAG: ProofSystem/ imports only Syntax; DerivedAxioms (raw constructors only) -> Combinators (extends the DerivedAxioms namespace) -> DeductionTheorem -> Propositional.Core -> Connectives -> GeneralizedNecessitation -> TemporalDerived -> DedekindDerived. A derived schema must live at the lowest module whose helpers suffice, and any theorem that an existing lower module already states as an alias (e.g. TemporalDerived.connectFutureThm for TC) forces the derivation below that module, or the repoint creates an import cycle. Engine-derived results (via derivable_of_validZTime/QTime) go in a Metalogic module above BXCanonical.Completeness and below Conservativity, which is cycle-safe because BXCanonical/Core/WeakCanonical/Bundle/Soundness import nothing from Conservativity or MinusLanguage.
